video_format.description: short = 30-55s 9:16 Short with replay loop; long_form = 3-15+ min multi-act episode (9:16 vertical micro-drama or 16:9 horizontal YouTube video) with multi-voice cast, Act-aware BGM, and chunked QA.

script_genre.description: Controls --lint-plan AI-slop rules: commentary (news/explainer/comedy voiceover) vs drama (scripted character fiction; skips commentary false positives on dialogue and checks melodrama clichés).

production_mode.description: Render engine: omni_video = Mode A (Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash); keyframe_motion = Mode B (zero video API key keyframes + 2x FFmpeg zoompan); hybrid = Mode A hero/hook clips + Mode B narrative shots via shots[].production_mode.

mode.description: Visual art style (distinct from production_mode render engine).

aspect_ratio.description: 9:16 = 1080x1920 vertical Shorts or serialized micro-dramas; 16:9 = 1920x1080 horizontal long-form YouTube episodes or explainers.

ending_style.description: replay_loop = Shorts dual-anchor loop back to Shot 1; cliffhanger = serialized multi-episode drama hook (holds tension in make_bgm.py); outro = standalone long-form conclusion/End-Screen slate.

voice.description: Default/fallback neural TTS voice (e.g., en-US-AvaNeural, en-US-EmmaNeural, en-GB-SoniaNeural).
WordBoundary-verified edge-tts neural voice (e.g., en-GB-SoniaNeural, en-US-AvaNeural, en-GB-RyanNeural, en-US-EmmaNeural, en-GB-ThomasNeural).

rate.description: Speech rate offset such as '+14%' or '+4%'.

pitch.description: Pitch offset such as '-2Hz' or '+4Hz' (keep within -6Hz..+6Hz).

keyword_color.description: Optional speaker-specific ASS BGR hex accent color (e.g., '&H00D7FF&') for kinetic captions.

voice_cast.description: Multi-voice speaker map for long-form episodes (maps shot.speaker to voice, rate, pitch, and optional caption accent color).

tts_pronunciations.description: Optional map of clean display strings to phonetic TTS strings (e.g., {"AWS": "A W S", "Pei Xuan": "Pay Shwen", "911": "nine-one-one"}). Applied during TTS synthesis while captions render dialogue_or_vo.

bgm_source.description: retrieved_track = instrumental via retrieve_music.py; procedural = synthesized stem via make_bgm.py; procedural_act_aware = multi-act score locked to shot_timings.json act boundaries and bgm_intensity.

bgm_query.description: Optional search query or style hint for retrieve_music.py when bgm_source is retrieved_track.

ambience_bed.description: Optional subtle -36 dBFS room-tone bed mixed by sfx_engine.py --ambience so silent pauses never drop to digital mute.

caption_style.description: kinetic_keyword = word-by-word pop with semantic highlights; karaoke_chunk = bounce-pop phrase chunks; clean_subtitle = calm static lower-third subtitles (zero bounce/tilt); none = skip burned-in ASS (use captions.srt for YouTube CC).

caption_font_size.description: ASS caption font size (defaults: 86 on 1080x1920, 62 on 1920x1080).

caption_margin_v.description: ASS MarginV offset from bottom in px (defaults: 420 on 1080x1920 vertical, 96 on 1920x1080 horizontal to clear YouTube scrub bar).

caption_tilt.description: Alternating keyword-line tilt in degrees (defaults: 2.5 on 9:16 kinetic_keyword, 0.0 on 16:9 or clean_subtitle).

caption_keyword_color.description: Keyword highlight mode: 'auto' (semantic neon), 'palace' (Imperial Gold / Fiery Crimson-Coral / Pearl Cyan-Jade), or an ASS BGR hex code.

highlight_keywords.description: Optional top-level words, names, or numbers to emphasize in kinetic captions.

character_references_path.description: Optional path to Stage 0 character_references.json with verified portraits, visual traits, and official mascot specs.

style_bible.description: Verbatim rendering, lighting, camera, and palette block appended to every shot prompt. Forbid signage with 'unadorned facades, plain empty surfaces, zero letters, zero digits, zero signage' (never 'blank signs').

sheet_path.description: Master empty-set location plate path (Template 1E, e.g., sheets/loc_throne_hall.png).

lighting.description: Locked key-light direction and color temperature for this set.

locations.description: Optional recurring set/location anchor registry for long-form architectural and lighting continuity.

props.description: Optional hero story prop registry to preserve visual consistency across Acts.

packaging.description: Optional Stage 1 / Stage 6 creator packaging bundle (thumbnails, cover frame, titles, description, pinned comment).

acts.description: Optional multi-act / chapter outline for long-form episodes (used for modular act authoring, Act-aware BGM dynamics, lighting color script, and YouTube chapter export).

title.description: Curiosity-preserving, non-spoiler chapter/act title (<= 35 chars recommended for YouTube chapters).

act_file.description: Optional modular act JSON path (e.g., acts/act_01.json).

bgm_intensity.description: Read directly by make_bgm.py --timings to set Act orchestration density.

lighting_mood.description: Act-level lighting and color-script note (e.g., warm amber lantern chiaroscuro vs cool moonlight).

rehook_question.description: Curiosity turn or escalation beat at the end of this Act to sustain viewer retention.

click_confirmation_0_5s.description: Long-form: how 0-5s pays off the title and thumbnail immediately.

visual_shift_every_2_3_shots.description: Long-form drama alternative to comedy gags: shot-scale, blocking, or emotional turn every 2-3 shots.

natural_speech_passed.description: True after verifying the script against references/spoken_english_guide.md (full grammar, varied cadence, zero AI_SLOP_SCRIPT patterns).

max_caption_chars.description: Max characters per caption line (aspect defaults: 18 on 9:16 at 86px; 36 on 16:9 at 62px).

state_sheets.description: Optional map of costume/visual states to locked turnaround sheet paths (e.g., {"veiled": "sheets/hero_veiled.png", "unveiled": "sheets/hero.png"}).

continuity_notes.description: Optional progressive damage, wardrobe, or prop continuity notes tracked across Acts and into the next episode.

reference_image_path.description: Optional path to Stage 0 verified portrait or official mascot reference image.

likeness_verified.description: True after checking the character's visual traits and turnaround sheet against Stage 0 references.

act.description: Act or chapter number (1..N) for long-form episodes.

production_mode.description: Optional per-shot override when top-level production_mode is hybrid.

shot_role.description: Optional dramatic function of the shot (use 'reaction' with empty dialogue_or_vo for silent beats).

location.description: Optional key referencing top-level locations map for architectural/lighting continuity.

character_states.description: Optional per-character state sheet selector for this shot (e.g., {"hero": "veiled"}).

focal_anchor.description: Zoompan focal lock in animate_shot_v2.py so rule-of-thirds subjects stay framed during zooms.

speaker.description: Optional speaker key referencing top-level voice_cast for multi-voice episodes.

voice.description: Optional per-shot neural TTS voice override.

rate.description: Optional per-shot TTS speech rate override (e.g., '+14%').

post_gap_sec.description: Optional silence pause after this shot (e.g., 0.25 at Act breaks, 0.0 on the final shot).

dialogue_or_vo.description: Spoken narration or dialogue in clean display English (leave empty '' for silent reaction beats); drives captions.

subtext.description: Optional writer-only dramatic intent note (not rendered).

tts_text.description: Optional phonetic override for TTS synthesis on this shot while dialogue_or_vo drives display captions.

highlight_keywords.description: Optional per-shot words or numbers to highlight in kinetic captions.

bgm_cue.description: Optional spotted-silence music automation cue honored by make_bgm.py --timings.

bgm_drop_sec.description: Duration in seconds for bgm_cue='drop_before_end' silence window before shot end.

sfx_pan.description: Stereo pan placement for SFX cue (0.0 = left, 0.5 = center, 1.0 = right).

dual_anchor_loop.description: True on the final shot of a Short to pass both the character sheet and shot_01 keyframe for replay loops. Keep false on long-form episodes.

loop_bridge.description: Final spoken phrase that connects naturally into Shot 1's opening line (required for Shorts; omit for long-form episodes).
